mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SENSOR_DATA (location, temperature, timestamp, humidity) VALUES (#{location}, #{temperature}, #{timestamp}, #{humidity})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sensor_criteria where sensor_type = 'Temperature' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sensor_criteria where sensor_type = 'Humidity' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sensor_criteria SET min_temperature = #{temperature}, updated_by = 'dashboard' WHERE sensor_type = 'Temperature' AND location = #{location}
UPDATE sensor_criteria SET max_temperature = #{temperature}, updated_by ='dashboard' where sensor_type = 'Temperature' AND location = #{location}
UPDATE sensor_criteria SET min_humidity = #{humidity}, updated_by ='dashboard' where sensor_type = 'Humidity' AND location = #{location}
UPDATE sensor_criteria SET max_humidity = #{humidity}, updated_by ='dashboard' where sensor_type = 'Humidity' AND location = #{location}
